purpose: development-only constrained ProTeGi pilot targeted at Configuration strict F1 with a matched-P0 recall floor
selection_policy: Development-only Gold-label selection inside frozen official train/dev partitions; the Dev subset was observed by the full run10 Dev evaluation and is not an independent fresh validation set; no test documents are used

window_policy.counting: actual build_text_windows output, not a length estimator

document_context.scope: explicit Long Form (SF) or SF (Long Form) definitions only

notes: The Train subset is reused because observing Train errors is part of ProTeGi optimization.
The Dev subset was observed in run10; this pilot is development-only and makes no fresh-Dev claim.
Strict Configuration F1 is primary; overlap F1 is diagnostic only.
Configuration strict recall must not fall below the matched P0 evaluated under the same abbreviation and WINDOW_SPLIT_V3 context.
The pilot is directional evidence only and cannot be promoted as a formal artifact.
